chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Whoever recites 'When he retires to his bed' (Idha awa), 'Say: O unbelievers' (Qul ya ayyuha al-kafirun), and 'Say: He is Allah, One' (Qul huwa Allahu ahad), Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will write for him an immunity from shirk (polytheism).

key_terms.إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ: When he retires to his bed (referring to Surah At-Takwir 81:16, often used as a short reference)
key_terms.الشِّرْكِ: Polytheism / Association of partners with God
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say: He is Allah, One (Surah Al-Ikhlas 112:1)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting Surah Al-Kafirun and Surah Al-Ikhlas before sleep?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the protective power of reciting Surah Al-Kafirun and Surah Al-Ikhlas before sleep, linking these recitations to divine immunity from shirk. This practice reflects the Shia tradition of using Quranic recitation as a means of spiritual purification and safeguarding against polytheistic inclinations in daily life. The emphasis on 'bari'ah' (immunity/exemption) suggests a comprehensive protection rather than merely a theoretical avoidance of shirk.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who recites when he retires to his bed [109:1] (Say: O unbelievers) Chapter 109) and [112:1] Say He Allah is One (Chapter 112), Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic would Write for him an immunity from the Shirk (association with Allahazwj)’.
en.sarwar: 23. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Whoever at the time of going to bed reads Chapter 109 of the Holy Quran, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will write down for him immunity from polytheism.”
